easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.
